learning.candidate_gate: current correct gain >=1/48, historical old-correct loss <=2/72 per decision, current format >=0.95, structural validity and rollback retained
learning.memory: full original feedback, raw/abstract/skill consolidation; gated commit
learning.graph_scope: All VQA train, selection, historical VQA anchors, development and confirmation use graph; other-task anchors preserve original direct coordinate-safe interface

development.use: previous study development examples; diagnostic only, no arm or checkpoint selection

confirmation.source: unused h_search groups/pixels reassigned as study-only confirmation before any model outputs; exclude all previous memberships before joining targets
confirmation.primary: GN versus G0: same Agent execution and initial harness; only fresh feedback learning differs
secondary: GN versus GT direct-trained memory transfer
GT versus DT same prior state, Agent versus direct
GN versus D0 direct no-memory reference
confirmation.read_after: FROZEN_SELECTION.json after both learning batches; all six arms mandatory
confirmation.positive: descriptive net exact-match gain GN-G0 >0; statistical evidence separately if paired95 lower>0; GF comparison always disclosed

shared_answer_interface: same shortest answer / digits for count / semicolon for multiple items; no answer vocabulary; different from old experiments
limitations: train48/selection48/development80 reused from prior direct experiment, not new independent discovery
confirmation newly allocated before outputs, not original test; patient isolation unverified
one seed, frozen model, same underlying VLM for controller and tools
old direct-trained state selected in previous experiment; no new control tuning
non-VQA historical anchors use unchanged direct interface
positive results not guaranteed; gate and failures retained
purpose: Complete VQA feedback learning through a bounded LangGraph agent; no guaranteed positive result

gate.historical_scope: per candidate relative to deployed predecessor; report cumulative losses separately

arm_definitions.G0: fresh empty HCL harness, original anchors, Agent, no new learning
arm_definitions.GF: static harness, same fixed six training examples appended to graph guidance
arm_definitions.GT: Agent with prior direct-trained committed state (previously selected fresh arm)
arm_definitions.GN: Agent trained from fresh memory through two full feedback/gate/candidate batches; final committed state, no best checkpoint selection
arm_definitions.DT: standard direct VLM using same prior state as GT

pre_execution_data_adjustment.reason: unused train_replay only has presence questions; six-type quotas infeasible
pre_execution_data_adjustment.action: reserve all 200 confirmation cases from unused h_search with original six-type quotas
